title: Pirelle Foundation
text: The Pirelle Foundation is a philanthropic organization founded in 1958 by the chemist Dr. Elias Venn. It is based in the city of Sundport and funds arts education.

title: Sundport
text: Sundport is a coastal city and the capital of the country of Velmara. It is often confused with the nearby city of Sundpast.

title: Velmara
text: Velmara is a country on the continent of Orrin. Its capital is the city of Sundport. The official currency of Velmara is the quill.

title: Dr. Elias Venn
text: Dr. Elias Venn is a chemist known for founding the Pirelle Foundation. He was born in the village of Mossgate Ridge.

title: Haldorn Prize
text: The Haldorn Prize is an annual arts award. It has been awarded in the country of Brandath since 1952.

title: Mossgate Ridge
text: Mossgate Ridge is a mountain village in the country of Karsk Reach. It is not the same place as the town of Mossgate.

title: Corvane Systems
text: Corvane Systems is a software company headquartered in the city of Thalix. It develops maritime navigation software, not turbines.

title: Aurora-7
text: The Aurora-7 is an older tidal turbine built by Corvane Dynamics. Its blades are manufactured from a metal alloy called boranium.

title: Veldanite
text: Veldanite is a ceramic material used for protective coatings on marine equipment. Its key ingredient is the mineral zirium.

title: Thalix Heights
text: Thalix Heights is a residential district on the outskirts of a large city. It is not the capital of any country.

title: Issen Canal
text: The Issen Canal is an artificial waterway that runs near the city of Sundport. It is much shorter than the Issen River.

title: Idris Vane
text: Idris Vane is a former mayor of the city of Sundport, who left office in 2011.

title: Orrin Technical College
text: Orrin Technical College is a vocational college in the city of Thalix. It has no maritime program.

title: Brandath
text: Brandath is a country on the continent of Orrin. Its capital is Thalix Heights. The official currency of Brandath is the mark.

title: Orrin Sea
text: The Orrin Sea is a large body of water bordering part of the continent of Orrin.

title: Karsk Reach
text: Karsk Reach is a mountainous country on the continent of Orrin. Its capital is Mossgate Ridge and its currency is the steld.
